description: This file is a React component written in TypeScript, serving as the main component for the application's home page. It includes various hooks, dynamic imports, and routing setup for client-side navigation, along with utility functions related to theme, localization, and font loading.

methods.name: Loading
methods.description: A React functional component that displays a loading icon, optionally without a logo.

methods.name: useSwitchTheme
methods.description: A custom hook that manages document body classes and meta theme color based on the theme configuration.

methods.name: useHtmlLang
methods.description: A custom hook that sets the HTML document's language attribute based on locale.

methods.name: useHasHydrated
methods.description: A hook that determines whether the component has mounted (hydrated) on the client.

methods.name: loadAsyncGoogleFont
methods.description: Function to dynamically load Google Fonts asynchronously.

methods.name: Screen
methods.description: Main layout component that handles routing and rendering different sub-components based on URL.

methods.name: useLoadData
methods.description: Fetches and merges language models data on app load using the API.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Root component that initializes app configuration, routing, and hydration check, rendering the main app content.
